title: Ziyarat of Imam Husayn on the Night of 15 Shaban
urduTitle: زیارت امام حسین شب پندرہ شعبان
intro: The brief special ziyarat for the night of 15 Shaban, distinct from the longer shared Rajab and Shaban form.
description: Read Ziyarat of Imam Husayn on the Night of 15 Shaban with arabic text, transliteration and english meaning, recitation context and source references.

blocks.text: The Prophets & The Angels visit Imam Hussain (as) on this night & performing the ziyarah is one of the most meritorious acts of this night.It has been said whoever wishes to shake hands with 124,000 prophets should perform this ziyarah on this night of 15th Sha'aban

blocks.english: All praise be to Allah; the Most High, the All-great.

blocks.arabic: والسَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ أيُّها الْعَبْدُ الصَّالِحُ الزَّكيُّ
blocks.transliteration: wa alssalamu `alayka ayyuha al`abdu alSSalihu alzzakiyy
blocks.english: Peace be upon you; O the righteous, pure servant (of Allah).

blocks.arabic: اُودِعُكَ شَهادَةً مِنِّي لَكَ تُقَرِّبُني إلَيْكَ فِي يَوْمِ شَفاعَتِكَ،
blocks.transliteration: udi`uka shahadatan minny laka tuqarribuny ilayka fi yawmi shafa`atika
blocks.english: I entrust with you a testimony of mine that takes me near you on the day of your intercession (for some people).

blocks.transliteration: ash-hadu annaka qutilta wa lam tamut
blocks.english: I bear witness that although you were slain, you have not died;

blocks.arabic: بَلْ بِرَجاءِ حَياتِكَ حَيِيَتْ قُلُوبُ شيعَتِكَ،
blocks.transliteration: bal biraja‘i hayatika hayiyat qulubu shi`atika
blocks.english: Rather the hearts of your adherents (Shi`ah) are living on the hope of your being alive;

blocks.transliteration: wa biziya‘i nurika ahtada alttalibuna ilayka
blocks.english: And by the light of your illumination have those seeking you been guided (to the right path).

blocks.arabic: وَأشْهَدُ أنَّكَ نُورُ اللهِ الَّذي لَمْ يُطْفَأْ وَلا يُطْفَأُ أبَداً،
blocks.transliteration: wa ash-hadu annaka nuru allahi alladhy lam yutfa wa la yutfa’u abadan
blocks.english: And I bear witness that you are verily the Light of Allah that has not and shall never be extinguished.

blocks.arabic: وَأنَّكَ وَجْهُ اللهِ الَّذي لَمْ يَهْلِكْ وَلا يُهْلَكُ أبَداً،
blocks.transliteration: wa annaka wajhu allahi alladhy lam yahlik wa la yuhlaku abadan
blocks.english: And you are verily the Face of Allah that has not and shall never be perishing.

blocks.transliteration: wa ash-hadu ann hadhihi alttrbata turbatuka
blocks.english: And I bear witness that this soil is yours,
And this holy precinct is yours.
And this death is the death of your body only,
While you have never been humiliated since Allah is the One Who is pouring honor upon you
And you have never been defeated since Allah is the One Who is supporting you.

blocks.arabic: هذِهِ شَهادَةٌ لي عِنْدَكَ إلى يَوْمَ قَبْضِ روُحي بِحَضْرَتِكَ،
blocks.transliteration: hadhihi shahadatun li `indaka ila yawmi qabzi ruhy bihazratika
blocks.english: I would like you to keep this testimony of mine with you up to the day when my soul will be grasped in the presence of you.

blocks.transliteration: wa alssalamu `alayka wa rahmatu allahi wa barakatuhu
blocks.english: Peace and Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon you.

blocks.text: Reference: Mafatih al-Jinan (by Sheikh Abbas Qummi)
The least one can do as a short salutation to Imam Hussain(as) is ,one may go to the terrace/elevated place, look left, right & towards the sky & recite :-

blocks.arabic: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّه السَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ وَرَحْمَةُ اللّه وَبَرَكَاتُهُ
blocks.transliteration: Assalamu Alalika Ya Aba Abdillah Assalamu Alaikum wa Rahmatullah e wabarakatoh
blocks.english: Peace be upon you; O Aba-`Abdullah! Peace and Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon you.

urduGuidance: یہ صفحہ زیارت امام حسین شب پندرہ شعبان کے لیے ہے۔ عربی متن اصل قراءت کے لیے ہے اور رومن تلفظ پڑھنے میں مدد دیتا ہے۔ انگریزی معنی الگ درج ہیں۔ ماخذ اور دوسری زیارات کے روابط صفحے کے آخر میں دیے گئے ہیں۔
